$comment: Relative token weights for feature 105 (data-model.md `token_weights`; FR-026): each ratio is that token type's list price divided by the uncached input price, so input = 1. Used ONLY to weight usage for comparison, never as a bill. Figures are Claude Opus 5.5 list prices ($4 input, $20 output per MTok; cache reads $0.20 per MTok, an Opus 5.5 exception to the usual 0.1x; 5-minute cache writes 1.25x and 1-hour cache writes 2x the input price), read from the public pricing page on the asOf date. Pushed to the store with `node scripts/cc-usage.mjs weights push`; update asOf with every change.
